mapper.select: select ppi.* from plm_postloan_inspection ppi where ppi.postLoan_inspection_id = #{postloanInspectionId}

SELECT hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_class, hbm.associated_division, hbmrr.bp_category, hbmrr.bp_type, hbc.description AS bp_category_description, hbt.description AS bp_type_description FROM hls_bp_master hbm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mr.bp_id, mr.bp_category, mr.bp_type FROM ( SELECT -- ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY hbmr.bp_id ORDER BY hbmr.CREATION_DATE ) RN, IF ( @p = hbmr.bp_id, @rank := @rank + 1 ,@rank := 1 ) AS RN, @p := hbmr.bp_id as rank1, hbmr.bp_id, hbmr.bp_category, hbmr.bp_type FROM hls_bp_master_role hbmr,(SELECT @p := NULL ,@rank := 0)r) mr WHERE RN = 1 ) hbmrr ON hbm.bp_id = hbmrr.bp_id LEFT JOIN hls_bp_category hbc ON hbmrr.bp_category = hbc.bp_category LEFT JOIN hls_bp_type hbt ON hbmrr.bp_type = hbt.bp_type
hbmrr.bp_category NOT IN ( 'CREDIT_ORGANIZATION' )
AND hbm.bp_id = #{bpId}
AND hbm.bp_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')

SELECT allContracts.contract_id, allContracts.contract_type, allContracts.company_id, allContracts.contract_bp_name, allContracts.contract_prj_name, allContracts.bp_id, allContracts.contract_number, allContracts.CREATED_BY, allContracts.user_id FROM ( SELECT cc.contract_id, 'CON' AS contract_type, cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, prj.project_name AS contract_prj_name, cc.inception_of_lease, hbm.bp_id, cc.CREATED_BY, cc.company_id, sua.user_id FROM con_contract cc, hls_bp_master hbm, prj_project prj, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id AND cc.project_id = prj.project_id AND cc.inception_of_lease IS NOT NULL AND ( cc.contract_status = 'INCEPT' OR cc.contract_status = 'PENDING' ) AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.company_id = #{companyId} AND cc.tenant_id = #{bpId} and cc.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id and cc.company_id = fea.company_id and cc.company_id = sua.company_id UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ff.contract_id, 'FCT' AS contract_type, ff.contract_number, hbm.bp_name AS contract_bp_name, fctp.project_name AS contract_prj_name, ff.rate_valid_from AS inception_of_lease, hbm.bp_id, ff.CREATED_BY, ff.company_id, sua.user_id FROM ( SELECT fct.contract_id, fct.contract_number, fct.rate_valid_from, fct.company_id, fct.project_id, fct.CREATED_BY, fct.employee_id FROM fct_contract fct LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_ln cprl ON fct.contract_id = cprl.source_doc_id LEFT JOIN csh_payment_req_hd cprh ON cprl.payment_req_id = cprh.payment_req_id WHERE cprh.payment_req_status = 'APPROVED' AND fct.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fct.company_id = #{companyId} ) ff, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project fctp, fct_project_bp fpb, fnd_employee_assigns fea, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE ff.project_id = fctp.project_id AND ff.project_id = fpb.project_id AND fpb.bp_role_type = 'SELLER' AND fpb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND hbm.bp_id = #{bpId} and ff.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id and ff.company_id = fea.company_id and ff.company_id = sua.company_id ) allContracts
